attr.title: RPG2LX - RPG Maker MV HUB
attr.desc: HUB for RPG Maker MV games: a lightweight native engine (QuickJS + SDL2) that runs the original corescripts and plugins, plus an optional NW.js browser engine for games whose plugins need a real browser. Per-game engine choice and button-to-keyboard mapping.
attr.inst: Copy each complete RPG Maker MV game into its own folder inside ports/rpg2lx/games/. Direct projects and projects inside www/ are detected. The browser engine needs the rpg2lx/nwjs folder and PortMaster's Westonpack runtime. Saves (.rpgsave) and settings are kept outside game assets.
